name: Powered_Concrete
title: Powered Concrete
author: Squishy1870; original mod by JuneGame
description: Powered Concrete adds concrete, refined concrete, and hazard concrete tiles that carry electric coverage through the floor. Factorio 2.0 compatible, no flib dependency, exact tile-by-tile powered floor behaviour, improved runtime syncing, and Q/pipette support for all powered tile variants.
